abstract: We apply an augmented gravity model to examine the impact of economic structure on bilateral trade flows among the Central Asian and South Caucasus countries. We find nuanced effects of economic complexity, innovation, and resource dependence on trade elasticity with respect to income and distance barriers. Greater economic complexity of both trade partners and resource dependence of importing economy weaken the effect of market potential on bilateral trade. Similarly, greater economic complexity and higher innovation activities of importing economies diminish the negative effect of distance. However, in some instances, high innovation activities of importing economy increase the size barrier, and greater innovation and higher resource dependence of exporting country reinforce the distance barrier of trade flows. We also analyse the temporal effects and the role of political environment. Our findings provide important insights for the role of economic structure on decreasing distance and size barriers of trade.
title: International trade, distance, and economic structure: the case of Central Asian and South Caucasus countries

abstract: With the deepening of China’s industrial green transformation, traditional environmental regulation policies, while effective in promoting enterprises’ passive emission reduction behaviours, struggle to stimulate sustained green technological innovation. As a key driving force for technological transformation, the digital economy offers a new pathway for enhancing green production efficiency. This study explores how the digital economy influences China’s green industrial productivity using provincial panel data from 2011 to 2023. A super-efficiency SBM model with undesirable outputs measures green production efficiency, and a digital economy index is constructed using the entropy method. A spatial econometric model analyzes this relationship, supplemented by mediation and threshold effect models to reveal underlying mechanisms. The findings highlight three key points: (1) The digital economy significantly improves green industrial efficiency. (2) Human capital accumulation and industrial structure upgrading serve as the primary mediating pathways through which the digital economy drives green industrial production efficiency. (3) A threshold effect in human capital indicates that once it surpasses a certain level, the impact of the digital economy on green efficiency increases significantly. These results suggest that accelerating digital transformation and integrating digital technologies with industrial production are essential for enhancing green industrial efficiency and promoting sustainable development.

title: Can the digital economy promote green industrial productivity? Evidence from China

abstract: This article evaluates the out-of-sample exchange rate predictability of exchange rate models using real-time and revised data for 10 countries from 1973 to 2024 across short and long forecast horizons. Employing directional change tests and economic evaluation, we find that real-time data significantly enhances the performance of the most successful specifications at the shortest forecast horizon. However, this advantage is more elusive at longer horizons, as data revisions correct initial errors. We examine the models based on monetary, purchasing power parity, and Taylor rule fundamentals, as well as the uncovered interest rate parity model augmented with inflation. Using real-time data, models with Taylor-rule fundamentals exhibit superior predictive accuracy at the shortest horizon and offer the highest economic gains at all forecast horizons, while the UIRP model augmented with either U.S. and foreign inflation or U.S. inflation demonstrates superior predictive ability over longer horizons. Notably, the UIRP model with inflation shows stronger directional accuracy with real-time data at all horizons than with revised data. Additionally, we introduce geopolitical risk into the model with Taylor rule fundamentals to capture uncertainty from wars, terrorism, and political tensions. This model yields the highest economic gains and superior out-of-sample performance at the 1-quarter horizon.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了汇率模型在样本外汇率可预测性方面的表现，利用1973年至2024年间10个国家的实时与修订数据，覆盖短期和长期预测区间。通过方向变化检验和经济评估，我们发现实时数据显著提升了最成功模型在最短预测区间内的表现。然而，在较长区间内这一优势较难维持，因为数据修订修正了初始误差。我们考察了基于货币、购买力平价和泰勒规则基本面的模型，以及加入通胀因素的无抛补利率平价模型。使用实时数据时，泰勒规则基本面模型在最短区间内展现出卓越的预测准确性，并在所有预测区间内提供最高的经济收益，而加入美国及外国通胀或仅美国通胀的UIRP模型在较长区间内表现出更强的预测能力。值得注意的是，加入通胀的UIRP模型在所有区间内使用实时数据时，方向准确性均优于修订数据。此外，我们将地缘政治风险引入泰勒规则基本面模型，以捕捉战争、恐怖主义和政治紧张局势带来的不确定性。该模型在1季度区间内实现了最高的经济收益和优越的样本外表现。
title: Out-of-sample exchange rate predictability with real-time and revised data
title_zh: 实时数据与修订数据下的样本外汇率可预测性

abstract: Using the horizontal ecological compensation policy (HECP) as a quasi-natural experiment and data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2008–2019, we examine the impact of HECP on the labour share of income within enterprises. Compared with the control group, HECP increases the labour share of income in the treated group by 1.03% points. Notably, this policy does not result in a pass-through effect between employee wages and benefits. Mechanism analysis indicates that HECP not only suppresses capital deepening within enterprises but also increases the input of labour factors and improves the structure of human capital, thus fostering an innovation substitution effect and ultimately increasing the labour share of income within enterprises. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that HECP is particularly effective for low-tax-burden enterprises, enterprises in regions with abundant labour resources, and enterprises facing less fiscal pressure. Furthermore, a series of robustness tests confirm the validity of our findings. This study offers a new explanation for understanding the dynamics of China’s labour share of income and provides policy insights for improving horizontal ecological compensation to optimize the labour capital distribution.
abstract_zh: 以横向生态补偿政策（HECP）作为准自然实验，利用2008-2019年中国A股上市公司数据，我们考察了HECP对企业劳动收入份额的影响。与对照组相比，HECP使处理组的劳动收入份额提高了1.03个百分点。值得注意的是，该政策并未在员工工资与福利之间产生传导效应。机制分析表明，HECP不仅抑制了企业内部的资本深化，还增加了劳动要素投入并改善了人力资本结构，从而促进了创新替代效应，最终提高了企业内部的劳动收入份额。异质性分析显示，HECP对低税负企业、劳动力资源丰富地区的企业以及财政压力较小的企业尤为有效。此外，一系列稳健性检验证实了我们研究结果的有效性。本研究为理解中国劳动收入份额的动态变化提供了新的解释，并为完善横向生态补偿以优化劳动资本分配提供了政策启示。

title: Horizontal ecological compensation and Labour share of income within enterprises: evidence from China
title_zh: 横向生态补偿与企业劳动收入份额：来自中国的证据

abstract: This study aims to model inflation dynamics by presenting the evidence supporting instability of the Phillips curve for the period covering the explicit inflation targeting (IT) adoption in Turkey as a small open economy. To this end, Bai and Perron approach is applied to capture possible breaks or instability associated with the structural changes in the hybrid New Keynesian Phillips curve (NKPC) estimation, using quarterly data from 2006:q1 to 2023:q4. The empirical findings reveal that the hybrid model of the NKPC with the control variables gives unstable parameter estimations with significant structural breaks which can be related to some structural changes the Turkish economy experienced for post IT periods. The results also put forward that the inflation-output gap relationship produces larger amount of parameter in high inflation period implying that the Phillips curve steepens with changing price setting behaviour and the effects of reel exchange rate and oil prices on domestic inflation rate. Based on these findings, the weaker anchored expectations may increase the output cost because of the changing trade-off between inflation and output gap. The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey (CBRT) should take its unstable structure into account in the inflation targeting process.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过呈现支持土耳其这一小型开放经济体在明确采纳通胀目标制（IT）期间菲利普斯曲线不稳定性的证据，来对通胀动态进行建模。为此，采用Bai和Perron方法，以捕捉混合新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线（NKPC）估计中与结构性变化相关的可能断点或不稳定性，使用2006年第一季度至2023年第四季度的季度数据。实证结果表明，包含控制变量的NKPC混合模型给出了不稳定的参数估计，并伴有显著的结构性断点，这些断点可能与土耳其在后通胀目标制时期经历的一些结构性变化有关。结果还指出，在高通胀时期，通胀-产出缺口关系产生的参数值更大，这意味着菲利普斯曲线随着价格设定行为的变化而变得更加陡峭，同时实际汇率和石油价格对国内通胀率也有影响。基于这些发现，较弱的锚定预期可能因通胀与产出缺口之间权衡关系的改变而增加产出成本。土耳其共和国中央银行（CBRT）在通胀目标制过程中应考虑其不稳定的结构。
authors: Salih Yildirim Kadir Y. Eryigit a Department of Economics
title: A New Keynesian Phillips curve estimation for a small open economy in the presence of structural changes: empirical evidence from Turkey
title_zh: 结构变化下小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线估计：来自土耳其的经验证据

abstract: This study empirically examines the use of capital flows as a tool of economic statecraft by the Gulf Arab states in Egypt, with a particular focus on Qatar’s investments from 2005 to 2023, encompassing phases of support, the suspension of diplomatic relations, and renewed diplomacy. While empirical research on the Gulf states’ use of economic statecraft is growing, significant gaps remain. This study tests the hypothesis that Qatar/Gulf investments have been used as instruments of economic statecraft. It provides a seminal exploration of the impact of political frictions between Egypt and Qatar on FDI inflows from Qatar to Egypt. Using panel data on FDI flows to Egypt, the study employs a gravity model covering the period from 2005 to 2023. The analysis evaluates the effects of several political shocks, such as the Qatar blockade and the Al Ula Agreement, on capital flows. The findings reveal that Qatar’s investment flows into Egypt, as well as those from other Gulf countries, hinge on the state of bilateral relations and the presence of like-minded administrations. This confirms that capital flows are part of the Gulf’s economic statecraft.
abstract_zh: 本研究实证考察了海湾阿拉伯国家在埃及将资本流动用作经济治国工具的情况，特别关注卡塔尔2005年至2023年间的投资，涵盖支持阶段、外交关系中断及外交重启阶段。尽管关于海湾国家运用经济治国手段的实证研究日益增多，但仍存在显著空白。本研究检验了卡塔尔/海湾投资被用作经济治国工具的假设，首次深入探讨了埃及与卡塔尔之间的政治摩擦对卡塔尔对埃及外国直接投资流入的影响。利用埃及外国直接投资流入的面板数据，本研究采用覆盖2005年至2023年期间的引力模型进行分析。分析评估了若干政治冲击（如卡塔尔封锁和《欧拉协议》）对资本流动的影响。研究结果显示，卡塔尔对埃及的投资流入以及其他海湾国家的投资流入，取决于双边关系的状态及是否存在志同道合的政府。这证实了资本流动是海湾国家经济治国手段的一部分。
authors: Ahmed Shoukry Rashad a College of Interdisciplinary Studies
UAEb Mohammed Bin Rashid School of Government, Dubai
title: How shifting diplomatic relations affect Gulf foreign investments: the case of Egypt
title_zh: 外交关系变化如何影响海湾国家对外投资：以埃及为例
